item.title: Aga Khan University Launches AI-Powered Cough Detection Project to Combat Tuberculosis in Tanzania
item.description: Aga Khan University has launched the Kikohozi Classifier Project, an artificial intelligence-powered initiative aimed at enhancing early detection of tuberculosis and other respiratory diseases across five Tanzanian regions.
